n: Seeed Grove Beginner Kit for Arduino
t: An Arduino board with ten sensors and outputs already wired on one panel.
steps: Buy the kit from Seeed Studio or a store such as RobotShop or Rapid Online.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Plug the kit in with the included USB cable. Windows users may need the CP210x driver.
Pick Arduino Uno as the board in the Arduino IDE.
Open the Seeed wiki course and run Lesson 1 to blink the LED.
Work through the lessons for the buzzer, the screen and each sensor.
Check your kit version on the wiki. Newer kits need the new sensor code.
Try the Codecraft block course for a no-typing path.
meta: Wild Open. From $21.51. A few stores.
